Rent Roll — Annualised
query:
SELECT
	la.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:180",
	la.property_unit AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:210",
	la.tenant AS "Tenant:Link/Tenant:180",
	la.name AS "Lease:Link/PS Lease Agreement:150",
	la.lease_status AS "Lease Status:Data:110",
	la.start_date AS "Start:Date:95",
	la.end_date AS "End:Date:95",
	la.currency AS "Curr:Data:60",
	la.payment_frequency AS "Frequency:Data:110",
	la.rent_amount AS "Rent per Period:Currency:140",
	(la.rent_amount * CASE la.payment_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Rent (Annualised):Currency:150",
	IFNULL(la.total_periodic_charges, 0) AS "Charges per Period:Currency:150",
	(IFNULL(la.total_periodic_charges, 0) * CASE la.payment_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Charges (Annualised):Currency:160",
	((la.rent_amount + IFNULL(la.total_periodic_charges, 0)) * CASE la.payment_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Total Annual Billing:Currency:170",
	IFNULL(la.outstanding_balance, 0) AS "Lease Outstanding:Currency:150"
FROM `tabPS Lease Agreement` la
WHERE la.docstatus = 1
	AND la.company = %(company)s
	AND la.lease_status IN ('Active', 'Expiring Soon')
ORDER BY la.property ASC, la.property_unit ASC

name: Tenant Arrears — Ageing
query:
SELECT
	si.customer AS "Tenant / Customer:Link/Customer:200",
	si.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:180",
	si.property_unit AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:200",
	si.ps_lease_agreement AS "Lease:Link/PS Lease Agreement:150",
	si.name AS "Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:160",
	si.posting_date AS "Posted:Date:95",
	si.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:95",
	si.status AS "Status:Data:90",
	si.currency AS "Curr:Data:60",
	GREATEST(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date), 0) AS "Days Overdue:Int:110",
	si.grand_total AS "Invoice Total:Currency:130",
	si.outstanding_amount AS "Outstanding:Currency:130",
	CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) <= 0 THEN si.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END AS "Current (Not Due):Currency:140",
	CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN si.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END AS "1-30 Days:Currency:120",
	CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN si.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END AS "31-60 Days:Currency:120",
	CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN si.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END AS "61-90 Days:Currency:120",
	CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.due_date) > 90 THEN si.outstanding_amount ELSE 0 END AS "90+ Days:Currency:120"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
	AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
	AND si.company = %(company)s
ORDER BY si.due_date ASC, si.customer ASC, si.name ASC

name: Occupancy by Property
query:
SELECT
	pu.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:230",
	COUNT(*) AS "Total Units:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Occupied:Int:95",
	SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Vacant' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Vacant:Int:85",
	SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Reserved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Reserved:Int:95",
	SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Under Maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Under Maintenance:Int:140",
	SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sold:Int:75",
	CONCAT(FORMAT(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), ' %%') AS "Occupancy %% (All Units):Data:160",
	CONCAT(FORMAT(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status = 'Occupied' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN pu.unit_status IN ('Occupied', 'Vacant', 'Reserved', 'Under Maintenance') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1), ' %%') AS "Occupancy %% (Lettable):Data:170"
FROM `tabProperty Unit` pu
INNER JOIN `tabPS Property` p ON p.name = pu.property
WHERE p.company = %(company)s
GROUP BY pu.property
ORDER BY pu.property ASC

name: Lease Expiry & Renewal Pipeline
query:
SELECT
	la.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:180",
	la.property_unit AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:200",
	la.tenant AS "Tenant:Link/Tenant:180",
	la.name AS "Lease:Link/PS Lease Agreement:150",
	la.lease_status AS "Lease Status:Data:110",
	la.end_date AS "Expiry Date:Date:100",
	DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) AS "Days Remaining:Int:120",
	CASE
		WHEN DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) < 0 THEN 'Already Expired'
		WHEN DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 30 THEN '0-30 Days'
		WHEN DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 60 THEN '31-60 Days'
		WHEN DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 90 THEN '61-90 Days'
		WHEN DATEDIFF(la.end_date, CURDATE()) <= 180 THEN '91-180 Days'
		ELSE 'Beyond 180 Days'
	END AS "Expiry Bucket:Data:140",
	la.payment_frequency AS "Frequency:Data:110",
	la.rent_amount AS "Current Rent per Period:Currency:170",
	(la.rent_amount * CASE la.payment_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Rent at Risk (Annualised):Currency:180",
	la.notice_period_days AS "Notice Days:Int:105",
	la.renewal_option AS "Renewal Option:Check:120",
	(SELECT lr.name FROM `tabLease Renewal` lr WHERE lr.original_lease = la.name AND lr.docstatus < 2 ORDER BY lr.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Renewal Doc:Link/Lease Renewal:150",
	IFNULL((SELECT lr2.status FROM `tabLease Renewal` lr2 WHERE lr2.original_lease = la.name AND lr2.docstatus < 2 ORDER BY lr2.creation DESC LIMIT 1), 'No Renewal Raised') AS "Renewal Status:Data:160",
	(SELECT lr3.new_rent_amount FROM `tabLease Renewal` lr3 WHERE lr3.original_lease = la.name AND lr3.docstatus < 2 ORDER BY lr3.creation DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Proposed New Rent:Currency:160"
FROM `tabPS Lease Agreement` la
WHERE la.docstatus = 1
	AND la.company = %(company)s
	AND IFNULL(la.lease_status, '') NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Cancelled')
	AND la.end_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL IFNULL(%(days_ahead)s, 180) DAY)
ORDER BY la.end_date ASC, la.property ASC

name: Rent Collection Summary
query:
SELECT
	si.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:220",
	CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0')) AS "Month:Data:95",
	COUNT(DISTINCT si.name) AS "Invoices:Int:90",
	SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Invoiced:Currency:150",
	SUM(si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) AS "Collected:Currency:150",
	SUM(si.outstanding_amount) AS "Outstanding:Currency:150",
	CONCAT(FORMAT(100.0 * SUM(si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(si.grand_total), 0), 1), ' %%') AS "Collection Rate %%:Data:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
	AND si.company = %(company)s
	AND IFNULL(si.property, '') <> ''
	AND si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
	AND si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY si.property, CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0'))
ORDER BY si.property ASC, CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0')) ASC

name: Deposit Liability Register
query:
SELECT
	IFNULL(pu.property, '(no unit linked)') AS "Property:Link/PS Property:190",
	sd.property_unit AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:200",
	sd.tenant AS "Tenant:Link/Tenant:190",
	sd.lease AS "Lease:Link/PS Lease Agreement:150",
	sd.name AS "Deposit:Link/Security Deposit:140",
	sd.received_date AS "Received:Date:100",
	sd.status AS "Status:Data:100",
	sd.currency AS "Curr:Data:60",
	sd.mode_of_payment AS "Mode of Payment:Data:140",
	sd.deposit_amount AS "Deposit Received:Currency:150",
	IFNULL(sd.deductions, 0) AS "Deductions:Currency:130",
	IFNULL(sd.refund_amount, 0) AS "Refunded:Currency:130",
	(IFNULL(sd.deposit_amount, 0) - IFNULL(sd.deductions, 0) - IFNULL(sd.refund_amount, 0)) AS "Net Deposit Held:Currency:160"
FROM `tabSecurity Deposit` sd
LEFT JOIN `tabProperty Unit` pu ON pu.name = sd.property_unit
WHERE sd.docstatus = 1
	AND sd.company = %(company)s
ORDER BY IFNULL(pu.property, 'zzz') ASC, sd.property_unit ASC, sd.received_date ASC

name: Profit by Property
query:
SELECT
	gl.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:230",
	gl.fiscal_year AS "Fiscal Year:Link/Fiscal Year:120",
	SUM(CASE WHEN acc.root_type = 'Income' THEN gl.credit - gl.debit ELSE 0 END) AS "Income:Currency:165",
	SUM(CASE WHEN acc.root_type = 'Expense' THEN gl.debit - gl.credit ELSE 0 END) AS "Expense:Currency:165",
	SUM(gl.credit - gl.debit) AS "Net Profit:Currency:165",
	CONCAT(FORMAT(100.0 * SUM(gl.credit - gl.debit) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN acc.root_type = 'Income' THEN gl.credit - gl.debit ELSE 0 END), 0), 1), ' %%') AS "Net Margin %%:Data:140"
FROM `tabGL Entry` gl
INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = gl.account
WHERE gl.is_cancelled = 0
	AND gl.company = %(company)s
	AND IFNULL(gl.property, '') <> ''
	AND acc.root_type IN ('Income', 'Expense')
	AND gl.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
	AND gl.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY gl.property, gl.fiscal_year
ORDER BY gl.property ASC, gl.fiscal_year ASC

name: Vacancy and Void Loss
query:
SELECT
	pu.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:200",
	pu.name AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:215",
	pu.unit_type AS "Unit Type:Data:120",
	pu.unit_status AS "Status:Data:135",
	pu.listing_status AS "Listing Status:Data:130",
	pu.currency AS "Curr:Data:60",
	pu.rent_frequency AS "Rent Frequency:Data:125",
	IFNULL(pu.rent_amount, 0) AS "Market Rent per Period:Currency:180",
	(IFNULL(pu.rent_amount, 0) * CASE pu.rent_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Rent Lost p.a.:Currency:150",
	(IFNULL(pu.service_charge_amount, 0) * CASE pu.rent_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Service Charge Lost p.a.:Currency:190",
	((IFNULL(pu.rent_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pu.service_charge_amount, 0)) * CASE pu.rent_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) AS "Total Void Loss p.a.:Currency:175",
	ROUND(((IFNULL(pu.rent_amount, 0) + IFNULL(pu.service_charge_amount, 0)) * CASE pu.rent_frequency WHEN 'Monthly' THEN 12 WHEN 'Quarterly' THEN 4 WHEN 'Semi-Annually' THEN 2 WHEN 'Annually' THEN 1 WHEN 'Weekly' THEN 52 WHEN 'Fortnightly' THEN 26 ELSE 12 END) / 12, 2) AS "Void Loss per Month:Currency:165"
FROM `tabProperty Unit` pu
INNER JOIN `tabPS Property` p ON p.name = pu.property
WHERE pu.unit_status IN ('Vacant', 'Under Maintenance')
	AND p.company = %(company)s
ORDER BY pu.property ASC, pu.name ASC

name: Withholding Tax on Rent
query:
SELECT
	si.customer AS "Tenant / Customer:Link/Customer:215",
	si.property AS "Property:Link/PS Property:185",
	si.property_unit AS "Unit:Link/Property Unit:195",
	CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0')) AS "Period:Data:95",
	si.currency AS "Curr:Data:60",
	COUNT(DISTINCT si.name) AS "Invoices:Int:90",
	SUM(sii.base_net_amount) AS "Rent Invoiced (Net of VAT):Currency:190",
	IFNULL(%(wht_rate)s, 8) AS "WHT Rate %%:Float:110",
	ROUND(SUM(sii.base_net_amount) * IFNULL(%(wht_rate)s, 8) / 100, 2) AS "WHT Withheld:Currency:150",
	ROUND(SUM(sii.base_net_amount) * (100 - IFNULL(%(wht_rate)s, 8)) / 100, 2) AS "Net After WHT:Currency:150"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name AND sii.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice'
INNER JOIN `tabAccount` acc ON acc.name = sii.income_account
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
	AND si.company = %(company)s
	AND acc.root_type = 'Income'
	AND (
		IFNULL(si.ps_lease_agreement, '') <> ''
		OR sii.item_code IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.rent_item FROM `tabPS Lease Agreement` l WHERE IFNULL(l.rent_item, '') <> '')
	)
	AND si.posting_date >= %(from_date)s
	AND si.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
GROUP BY si.customer, si.property, si.property_unit, si.currency, CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0'))
ORDER BY CONCAT(YEAR(si.posting_date), '-', LPAD(MONTH(si.posting_date), 2, '0')) ASC, si.customer ASC
